title: Touring Japan but not performing in Tokyo
summary: Troops weren't allowed in Tokyo, so the show played Kyoto and cities across Honshu.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Well, where did you perform here, then?
I don't think we played in Tokyo. We played at the (?). Now, we performed all over Japan. But I don't think we did a show in the city of Tokyo.
No, because the troops were to be outside.

Well, the troops were... Yeah, they weren't allowed into Tokyo, you know. Yeah, we didn't no show in Tokyo. But we went to Kyoto and all the different cities all around. What they call Hansho, the island of Hansho, we did shows all over.
